forecast.method: weighted moving average of the last 3 complete months (weights 1, 2, 3) with a monthly seasonality index
forecast.season_note: The season is read from two years of history, the fewest a season can be read from: two years cannot fully tell a one-time change of level between them from the season itself, so the forecast's monthly shape is less certain than more years would make it.
forecast.products_at_stockout_risk_reason: stock figures are not supported in v1: DataClarity v1 analyses sales, not inventory, so no product has a stockout risk
